Subject: [PATCH 3/4] fix(context): apply headers staged before c.res is
 materialized

Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8

`c.header()` writes into `#preparedHeaders` until something reads `c.res`.
The setter only merged from `#res`, so when no middleware had touched `c.res`
every header staged before `next()` was dropped as soon as a handler returned
a raw `Response` — including `Set-Cookie`.

The setter now falls back to `#preparedHeaders`. Assigning `undefined` clears
them as well, preserving `c.res = undefined` as a full reset.

index c793c180b0..9d3f766887 100644

+++ b/src/context.ts
@@ -412,16 +412,20 @@ export class Context<

    */
   set res(_res: Response | undefined) {
-    if (this.#res && _res) {
+    // Headers staged by `c.header()` live in `#preparedHeaders` until something
+    // reads `c.res` and materializes it. Falling back to them keeps those
+    // headers from being dropped when nothing has read `c.res` yet.
+    const preparedHeaders = this.#res ? this.#res.headers : this.#preparedHeaders
+    if (preparedHeaders && _res) {
       _res = createResponseInstance(_res.body, _res)
       // `Set-Cookie` is handled after the loop rather than inside it: it is the
       // only header that may legitimately appear more than once, so `entries()`
       // yields it once per occurrence and would re-merge values it just wrote.
       // Captured before the merge below deletes them from `_res`.
       const incomingCookies = _res.headers.getSetCookie()
-      const preparedCookies = this.#res.headers.getSetCookie()
+      const preparedCookies = preparedHeaders.getSetCookie()
 
-      for (const [k, v] of this.#res.headers.entries()) {
+      for (const [k, v] of preparedHeaders.entries()) {
         if (k !== 'content-type' && k !== 'set-cookie') {
           _res.headers.set(k, v)
         }
@@ -439,6 +443,12 @@ export class Context<
         }
       }

Fixed the `Context.res` `Set-Cookie` merge bug.

**Change**
- `src/context.ts:414-443`: `Set-Cookie` merging is now handled once outside the header loop. Cookies already on the context and cookies carried by the incoming `Response` are both appended, instead of deleting the incoming cookies and keeping only the context's.
- `src/context.test.ts:430-459`: Updated the existing re-assignment test to require cookies from both responses, and added a regression test covering middleware cookie + handler cookie.

**Verification**
```
pnpm exec vp test --run src/context.test.ts
# Test Files 1 passed, Tests 64 passed

pnpm exec vp test --run src/hono.test.ts src/context.test.ts
# Test Files 2 passed, Tests 289 passed

pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit
# passed
```

Changes are left unstaged for review.
